contexts.text: Abominable = filthy cupidities.
Evils are then regarded as abominable.
The abomination of desolation = the state of the Church when there is no love and charity, for then abominable things reign.
The abomination of desolation = the vastation of the Church. Explained.
An abomination to the Egyptians = that they are in what is opposite. Explained.
The abomination of the Egyptians = the separation of scientifics. Explained.
Nothing is more abominable there than profaned truth...
Abomination = infernal noisomeness and defilement.
Hence it is that adulteries are so wicked, and are called abominations.
Still more has he religion who abominates them (adulteries).
At last he abominates it.
He who abominates them as so many dusky and burning devils...
Abominations = profanations of what is holy. AR 729. SE 1005 et seq. Described.
The abominable = those who are in all kinds of evils, for abominations in general = the evils named in the last six commandments. Illustrated.
To work abomination = to do evils, for abominations = evils of every kind, especially those named in the decalogue.
The abomination of desolation = the falsification and deprivation of all truth.
Hence is the abomination of desolation.
General article. See BE 74.
These abominations (Arianism and Socinianism). TCR 380:3.
Four wicked abominations at once are thus committed. Enumerated.
The abomination of devastation = the devastation of the Church, which is effected when there is no longer any truth or faith, because no good or charity.
Abominations from between the teeth = adulterations of the knowledges of good.
Abomination before Jehovah = every evil against the Divine itself.
An abominable branch = truth falsified.
The bird of abominations = faith alone. Explained.
Abominations = profanations of good. Defined. Explained.
On the abomination of desolation. General article. See also Inv 0., the Preface to Invitation to the New Church.

These Satanic spirits are called the abomination of desolation because they are all in falsities as to faith and in evils as to life; the inner things of their minds are infernal, and the outer things are as it were heavenly by virtue of feigned morality.
The abomination of desolation on earth also. Representation.
